correctness.rationale: The 120 doubled coordinate roots in Z[phi], with phi^2=phi+1, all have squared norm four. Four Coxeter reflections preserve these vertices and generate 14,400 distinct elements; an icosahedral vertex-figure stabilizer bounds the full symmetry group above by 120*120. Independent exact arithmetic rebuilt the root set, group, eight distinct stabilizer distance shells, all 280,840 unordered triples, 56 orbit closures, 56 distinct Gram signatures, and the induced versus intrinsic S3 label permutations for all 56 representatives. All but the 2,400-element mutually orthogonal orbit extend every intrinsic permutation; that orbit has intrinsic S3 order six but induced C3 order three. The exact finite complete orbit enumeration proves the fixed 120-vertex result, not a claim for all polytopes.
